# clavis env rm

<p class="cli-lead">Delete an environment and the secrets in it</p>

<div class="cli-usage">

```sh
clavis env rm SLUG [flags]
```

</div>

Also available as `delete`.

Delete an environment together with its secrets, their history and
personal overrides. It cannot be undone, and a project must keep at
least one environment. You type the environment's slug to confirm;
without a terminal, pass `--yes`.

## Examples

```sh
clavis env rm qa
```

<p class="cli-example-title">In a script</p>

```sh
clavis env rm qa --yes
```

## Flags

<dl class="cli-flags">
<div class="cli-flag" id="flag-yes"><dt><code>--yes</code></dt><dd>skip the confirmation (required without a terminal)</dd></div>
</dl>

## Details

Needs permission to manage environments. The deletion is recorded in the audit log. `delete` is an alias.
